subject: MAP: CynerTech POC — environment activation slate
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@cynertech.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: CynerTech POC — initial activation slate

Hi Alex — following our call earlier, attaching a short mutual action slate so we can lock timelines for the POC environment. Main items we need to finish before we flip the environment to test traffic: 

1) Org + access: create CynerTech org in Redwood Console and add 3 engineers (SAML optional). Owner: Irene Choi. Target: Mar 10.
2) API keys: issue scoped API key for staging (read/write tokens with request limits). Owner: Ben Carter. Target: Mar 9.
3) IP allowlist: CynerTech to confirm static egress IP ranges (we will add to allowlist). Attach: network-allowlist.csv. Target: Mar 8.
4) VPC peering: exchange VPC tags/subnet ranges + peering request (can be parallel to allowlist). Owner: Marissa Cole. Target: Mar 17 (depends on cloud ops windows).
5) Data residency & logging notes: confirm retention window and whether logs can be shipped to CynerTech SIEM. Owner: Neha Kapoor. Target: Mar 12.

I've attached a one-page MAP (redwood_map_v2.pdf) and a draft SOW for legal to review (cyner_sow_draft.docx). Please confirm the IP ranges and any blackout days next week that would block peering.

Next step: if ok, propose a 30-min technical kickoff on Mar 9 morning PT.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_map_v2.pdf, cyner_sow_draft.docx, network-allowlist.csv

From: Alex Green <alex.green@cynertech.com>

Subject: Re: MAP: CynerTech POC — initial activation slate

Thanks Ben — this looks good and aligns with what we discussed. Quick clarifications from our side: 

- API keys: we need the staging key to be scoped to model generation only (no admin calls) and TTL of 30 days for rotation—can Redwood issue a scoped key or do we need to create one in our org?
- IP allowlist: attaching our confirmed egress ranges below (we'll also upload to your portal): 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.128/25. We cannot schedule any peering changes between Mar 14–18 due to a maintenance window.
- VPC peering: our infra prefers peering via cross-account route tables in us-west-2. If Redwood needs peering in us-east-1 for any reason, that will delay us until Apr.

Also looping Sarah in from procurement — Sarah, can you confirm PO timeline? We expect to sign SOW by Mar 15 if legal reviews are quick.

Subject: Re: MAP: CynerTech POC — initial activation slate

Thanks Alex — got the ranges and the blackout window (Mar 14–18) noted. Short answers and owners below, plus an updated proposed mini-MAP with concrete handoffs: 

API keys
- Redwood can create the scoped staging key in the CynerTech org (recommended) with generation-only permissions and 30-day TTL. Owner: Ben Carter. Action: Ben will send key provisioning request and token policy by EOD Mar 4.

Org + access
- I will provision the org and invite the three engineers you listed. If you want SAML, we can attach your IdP; otherwise use invite flow. Owner: Irene Choi. Action: I will send invites Mar 5.

IP allowlist
- I uploaded your ranges to the portal and attached the CSV for reference. Please confirm the two ranges are final. Owner: CynerTech (Alex). Action: Reply to confirm; Redwood to apply once confirmed.

VPC peering
- Marissa will open the peering request. Because you prefer us-west-2, we'll target peering there — that keeps us off the Mar 14–18 blackout. Owner: Marissa Cole. Action: Marissa to initiate peering ticket Mar 9; coordinate with your cloud ops.

Data residency & logs
- Neha will follow up on retention windows and options for pushing logs to your SIEM. Expect a note by Mar 12.

Proposed MAP timeline (dates are proposal only):
- Mar 4: Ben sends API key policy + provisioning form
- Mar 5: Org invites sent by Irene
- Mar 8: CynerTech confirms IP ranges
- Mar 9: Technical kickoff (30 min) + Marissa opens peering ticket
- Mar 12: Logging/retention confirmation from Redwood
- Mar 15: SOW sign target
- Mar 17: Peering close target (subject to cloud ops).

I've also created a short shared doc and placed it in the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AxyExampleSharedDrive — feel free to add internal notes. If that timeline works, I'll create a DocuSign envelope for the SOW and share it with Sarah and procurement tomorrow.

Cheers —
Irene Choi
Solutions Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

Attachments: network-allowlist.csv

Subject: Re: MAP: CynerTech POC — environment activation slate (tech note)

Quick tech note from infra side:

- For the scoped API key, we recommend issuing an ephemeral key for the onboarding window and a long-lived service key for automated CI if you need it. Ephemeral sample curl to test key: 

  curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <STAGING_KEY>" \n    -d '{"input":"hello"}' \n    https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate

- For VPC peering, provide the account ID and subnet/cidr blocks. We'll submit the peering request and include route propagation instructions. Mar 9 kickoff is fine for us.

I'll open the peering ticket on Mar 9 and will ping the CynerTech cloud ops alias so we align on the exact CIDR and route tables.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
